_comment: Snapshot of RTDB app-data/media-programme-packs/folders-config. This is the folder list every club shows in Programme Packs. To change it: edit here, paste this whole object into RTDB at that path (replacing what's there), then run pp_bootstrap once from the Apps Script editor to create the matching Drive subfolder + folder-ids entry in every club. Keys starting with _ are ignored by the page; isSeeded:true means bootstrap creates that folder in every club. Slimmed v2.0 (19 Jun 2026): dropped Adverts and the other seeded folders down to these four. Old Drive folders from the previous structure are left in place (they only held test files) and simply no longer appear.

crest-logos.name: Crest & Logos
crest-logos.description: Club crest, wordmarks and sponsor logos.

club-info.description: Season info, stats and copy for the programme.
